title: Application
description: An app of this environment: its start-page tile and where the app proxy routes it. Added from the app's manifest in the portal; the portal's application list is the register of apps (REG-03). The URL is the environment's base URL + path.

requiredPermission.description: Permission needed to see the tile; the target app checks it again.

state.description: live = links to the module; coming_soon = shown, not clickable; hidden = not shown, still routed by the proxy while the app is built and tested (REG-07, REG-08).

plantIds.description: Plants the tile is shown for; null = all plants. Taken from the manifest's [app].plants on import (Mini-Apps, REG-09). With all plants selected the start page shows every tile.

path.description: Path behind the app proxy, e.g. '/processdata/' (REG-07).

upstreamHost.description: Host the app proxy forwards to, usually '127.0.0.1' (DEP-03); null = no proxy rule.

upstreamPort.description: Port of the app's Waitress server = [runtime].default_port = APP_PORT (REG-05); null = no proxy rule.

consumes.description: Master-data contracts the app consumes, from the last imported manifest, e.g. 'persons@1'.

manifestVersion.description: App version of the last imported manifest.

manifestImportedAt.description: When the manifest was last imported (UTC).

serviceName.description: Runtime Windows service name imported from the manifest; administrators may correct the deployed name.

monitoringExpected.description: Explicitly expected to run for monitoring incidents; unrelated to tile visibility.
